archaeopter-transvector.name: Archaeopter Transvector
archaeopter-transvector.transport: This unit can transport 6 SECUTARII, <FORGE WORLD> ELECTRO-PRIESTS,   <FORGE WORLD> TECH-PRIESTS, or  SECUTARII INFANTRY models. It cannot transport Belisarius Cawl.

skorpius-dunerider.name: Skorpius Dunerider
skorpius-dunerider.transport: This unit can transport 10 Secutarii Infantry or <Forge World> Infantry models. It cannot transport Belisarius Cawl, Kataphron Breacher or Kataphron Destroyer units.

terrax-pattern-termite-assault-drill.name: Terrax-pattern Termite Assault Drill
terrax-pattern-termite-assault-drill.transport: This unit can transport up to 12 friendly SECUTARII INFANTRY or <FORGEWORLD> INFANTRY models. It cannot transport BELISARIUS CAWL, KATAPHRON BREACHER or KATAPHRON DESTROYER models.

arc-grenade-cluster.name: Arc Grenade Cluster
arc-grenade-cluster.text: When this unit finishes making a Move action, select one enemy unit it moved over whilst making that Move action. Roll three D6, subtracting 1 from each result if that unit is a Character and adding 2 to each result if that unit is a VEHICLE; for each result of 4+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

bomb-rack.name: Bomb Rack
bomb-rack.text: After this unit makes a Move action, select one enemy unit it passed within 1" of during that Move action. Roll two D6; for each 3+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

lord-of-mars.name: Lord of Mars
lord-of-mars.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by friendly MARS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

archmagos.name: Archmagos
archmagos.text: At the start of the Generate Command Assets step, if this unit is a WARLORD and is on the battlefield, you generate one extra Command Asset.

master-of-machines.name: Master of Machines
master-of-machines.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to repair one friendly IMPERIUM VEHICLE unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that VEHICLE unit. Only one attempt to repair each unit can be made each turn.

galvanic-field.name: Galvanic Field
galvanic-field.text: Add 3" to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons FORGE WORLD units are equipped with whilst they are within 6" of any friendly units with this ability.

lord-of-the-machine-cult.name: Lord of the Machine Cult
lord-of-the-machine-cult.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly <Forge World> units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

mindlock.name: Mindlock
mindlock.text: Change this unit's Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics to 4+ whilst it is within 6" of at least one frendly FORGE WORLD TECH PRIEST unit.

master-of-the-machines.name: Master of the Machines
master-of-the-machines.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to repair one friendly <Forge World> Kastelan Robots unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that Kastelan Robots unit. Only one attempt to repair each unit can be made each turn.

siphoned-vigour.name: Siphoned Vigour
siphoned-vigour.text: If an enemy unit is destroyed within 1" of this unit, change this unit’s Save characteristic to 6+ for the rest of the battle.

incense-cloud.name: Incense Cloud
incense-cloud.text: This model is always an obscured target.

battle-protocols.name: Battle Protocols
battle-protocols.text: This unit has one of the abilities listed below, based on the order issued to its Detachment in the Orders phase. The ability lasts until the end of the turn. Note that even if that Detachment’s order subsequently changes, the ability this unit has for that turn does not.

advance.name: Advance
advance.text: Add 1 to saving throws made for this unit.

aimed-fire.name: Aimed Fire
aimed-fire.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by this unit with ranged weapons.

assault.name: Assault
assault.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by this unit with melee weapons.

emanatus-force-field.name: Emanatus Force Field
emanatus-force-field.text: Add 1 to saving throws made for this unit whilst it is within 6" of any other friendly <Forge World> Onager Dunecrawler units.

self-repair-mechanisms.name: Self-Repair Mechanisms
self-repair-mechanisms.text: At the start of th Action phase, you can remove one damage marker from this unit.

master-of-machines-2.name: Master of Machines
master-of-machines-2.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to repair one friendly FORGE WORLD or QUESTOR MECHANICUS VEHICLE unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that VEHICLE unit. Only one attempt to repair each unit can be made each turn.

broad-spectrum-data-tether.name: Broad Spectrum Data-Tether
broad-spectrum-data-tether.text: Add 1 to the Leadership characteristic of <Forge World> units whilst they are within 3" of any friendly units with this ability.

mag-inverter-shields.name: Mag-inverter Shields
mag-inverter-shields.text: Each time a blast marker is placed next to this unit whilst this unit is in base contact with any enemy units, roll one D6; on a 5+ place one blast marker next to one of those enemy units.

soar-away.name: Soar Away
soar-away.text: When this unit makes a Move action, it can Soar Away instead of moving. If it does, it is removed from the battlefield and placed into Tactical Reserves. When this unit arrives as reinforcements, set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" away from any enemy units. A unit cannot Soar Away if it was set up on the battlefield this turn, if there are any enemy units in base contact with it, or if there are any blast markers next to it.

command-uplink.name: Command Uplink
command-uplink.text: Friendly <FORGE WORLD> units can use this model's Leadership instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this model.

hover-jet.name: Hover Jet
hover-jet.text: At the start of the Action phase, you can declare that this unit will hover. If it does, then until the end of the phase, its Move characteristic changes to 20" but it loses the Supersonic ability.
